name: Elvish Scout
oracle_text: {G}, {T}: Untap target attacking creature you control. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by it this turn.
blocked_sentences: {G}, {T}: Untap target attacking creature you control. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by it this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only: true` option on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (a field on structs.PermanentShield read by primitives.damage_permanent / damage_player), so an activated ability can install a this-turn shield on its target that stops only COMBAT damage dealt to and dealt by that creature; the untap half is already the `untap` op on the same target
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` with dealt: to_and_by and duration: this_turn is the right shape but prevents ALL damage, so burn aimed at the creature and its noncombat damage would also be stopped (a strictly better card); the newly gained `combat_only` lives only on the `prevent_damage` static, which is continuous on a printed permanent, only stops damage dealt to what it matches, and cannot be installed on a target for a turn by a resolving ability
